components: Two independently prepared real triangle-plus-reference packages may have independently cycled hidden references. Native cycle comparisons and exchanges recover the target antiswap row exactly conditional on a reference branch occurring with probability one half; the unconditional zero-false-positive signal is half the target.

Equal-input vectors span fourteen of sixteen real dimensions. Positivity bounds any binary effect with no equal-input clicks by the remaining rank-two projector, giving a tight unconditioned efficiency ceiling one half relative to the target on orthogonal inputs. This is a zero-false-positive ceiling, not a universal efficiency bound without that condition.

For arbitrary positive real binary effects the sharp worst-coordinate error to the supplied target is 1/12. A native comparison plus independent one-in-three acceptance attains it; an independent random trit is an additional supplied resource, not derived randomness.
